'''Isulders Bane Agents of the Black Sun Droid Takeover''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Isulders Bane]]
* '''Published:''' 6 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Lucia's List|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif|label=Agents Of Black Sun}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents Of Black Sun
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed AOBS Bane DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

AotBS with battle droids and bounty hunters

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

AotBS 101

Keep Luke off the table with your massive amount of beat down characters while draining with vigos and inflicting direct damage.  this may not be a syllabus of a course anyone is taking now, but it is the primary objective of this deck.  If luke comes down, kill him.  In fact, if anything comes down, kill it (except starships of course)  You have enough ground pound to do whatever.  All your sites can be pulled which means no zeroes and multiple high destinies to help out characters like Aurra sing with her blaster, and boba fett bounty hunter with IG-88 and Dengar (4 battle destiny, 1 captured character, 2 'hit' ones).  what more could you ask for.  Well you could drain for 6 more, adding 2 direct damage.  Every turn that adds up. Fast.  One thing you must do in the deck is, if luke is in their deck, adapt to their strategy, if he isnt, keep xizor alive, and beat the junk out of any characters they dare to put down.  do this and you might just pass with a win.
